roles.name: Industry 4.0 Systems Architect
roles.description: Architects end-to-end smart factory connectivity, unified industrial IoT namespaces, and automated edge-to-cloud execution.
responsibilities: Architect Unified Namespace (UNS) based on MQTT and Sparkplug B across production lines
Integrate legacy PLCs, CNC machines, and SCADA systems with enterprise cloud platforms
Deploy edge industrial computing gateways running containerized microservices
Establish cybersecurity zones and conduits according to IEC 62443 industrial standards
roles.careerPath: Automation Engineer -> Industry 4.0 Architect -> VP of Digital Manufacturing

roles.name: Additive Manufacturing (3D Printing) Engineer
roles.description: Develops industrial metal and polymer 3D printing parameters, generative design topology, and post-processing qualification.
responsibilities: Optimize Direct Metal Laser Sintering (DMLS) and Selective Laser Sintering (SLS) print parameters
Perform generative design and topology optimization for lightweight aerospace/medical parts
Design support structures, build orientations, and thermal stress mitigation strategies
Manage post-processing heat treatments (HIP), CNC machining, and non-destructive surface testing
roles.careerPath: AM Technician -> Additive Manufacturing Engineer -> Lead Advanced Manufacturing Architect

roles.name: Digital Twin Specialist
roles.description: Creates real-time physics and telemetry digital replicas of plant machinery, production cells, and supply chain logistics.
responsibilities: Construct real-time 3D simulation twins of automated assembly cells and AGV fleets
Sync live sensor telemetry streams with digital models to predict machine failures
Run discrete-event simulations to identify production line bottlenecks and cycle time starvation
Provide plant operators with augmented reality (AR) machine diagnostic overlays
roles.careerPath: Simulation Engineer -> Digital Twin Specialist -> Director of Virtual Manufacturing

roles.name: Lean Six Sigma Master Black Belt
roles.description: Leads enterprise-wide Lean transformation, DMAIC process optimization, statistical yield improvement, and cultural change.
responsibilities: Coach plant leadership and Black Belts on complex DMAIC continuous improvement initiatives
Perform advanced ANOVA, Design of Experiments (DOE), and Gage R&R statistical studies
Eliminate manufacturing waste (Muda, Muri, Mura) across high-volume production facilities
Deliver multi-million dollar annual bottom-line cost savings and cycle time compressions
roles.careerPath: Process Engineer -> Six Sigma Black Belt -> Master Black Belt -> VP of Operational Excellence

roles.name: Industrial Cybersecurity Engineer
roles.description: Protects Operational Technology (OT), SCADA networks, PLCs, and safety instrumented systems from industrial cyber threats.
responsibilities: Implement the Purdue Model segmenting enterprise IT networks from factory-floor OT assets
Harden industrial control protocols (Modbus, Profinet, EtherNet/IP) against packet tampering
Perform threat hunting, asset discovery, and anomaly detection on OT network traffic
Conduct tabletop drills for ransomware containment on critical automated manufacturing lines
roles.careerPath: Network Security Engineer -> Industrial Cybersecurity Engineer -> Head of OT Security

roles.name: Operations Research Analyst
roles.description: Applies mathematical optimization, linear programming, and queueing theory to maximize supply chain throughput.
responsibilities: Formulate mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) models for multi-echelon inventory and scheduling
Optimize vehicle routing problem (VRP) algorithms to minimize fleet fuel and delivery times
Simulate stochastic factory queueing networks and supply disruption scenarios
Deploy automated solver pipelines providing weekly production schedules
roles.careerPath: Analytics Specialist -> Operations Research Analyst -> Director of Supply Chain Science

roles.name: Continuous Improvement Manager
roles.description: Fosters a Kaizen culture, facilitates Value Stream Mapping (VSM) workshops, and institutionalizes standard work practices.
responsibilities: Facilitate rapid improvement Kaizen events across stamping, machining, and assembly areas
Map current and future state Value Stream Maps (VSM) to eliminate non-value-added steps
Institutionalize visual management, Kamishibai audits, and leader standard work
Train shop-floor team leads on root-cause 5-Why and Fishbone problem solving
roles.careerPath: Continuous Improvement Specialist -> CI Manager -> Director of Operational Excellence

roles.name: Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) Specialist
roles.description: Deploys and maintains MES software tracking work-in-progress (WIP), OEE performance, genealogy, and electronic batch records.
responsibilities: Configure MES workflows, bill of materials (BOM), and digital recipe management
Calculate real-time Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE: Availability, Performance, Quality)
Implement electronic batch records (eBR) and serial lot genealogy tracking
Integrate MES software layers with enterprise ERP (SAP S/4HANA) and plant SCADA systems
roles.careerPath: MES Developer -> MES Specialist -> Lead Enterprise Manufacturing Architect

roles.name: Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) Manager
roles.description: Ensures chemical handling safety, air and water environmental emission permits, zero-injury culture, and regulatory compliance.
responsibilities: Direct plant hazardous waste management, wastewater discharge, and EPA Title V air permits
Conduct ergonomics assessments, noise dosimetry, and machine guarding safety reviews
Lead corporate sustainability reporting: Scope 1 and 2 emissions and zero-landfill milestones
Coordinate OSHA safety compliance, spill containment drills, and emergency response teams
roles.careerPath: EHS Specialist -> EHS Manager -> Director of Corporate EHS & Sustainability
